NERVES. [36] [Graph.]
Tremulous sensation through whole body.
Tired feeling ; lassitude ; inclination to sit down.
Amazingly weary and sleepy.
Debility, without pain, compelling him to groan.
Frequently feels faint, with partial loss of senses.
Weak exhaustion of whole body.
Sudden sinking of strength.
Binding, constricting pain in different parts, especially in gastric region ; sensation of lump in stomach, with constant beating as of two hammers ; great desire to vomit ; feels so tired that death would be a relief ; hates to be addressed, or to work, feels indifferent to everybody and everything ; constant chilliness as if skin were tightened over body ; great anguish before menses ; obstinate constipation.
Full of spasms. θ Amenorrhœa.
Contractions of muscles.
After local treatment of erysipelas, twitching of eyelids, which gradually spread to muscles of left side of face, and in course of two years developed into general convulsions of whole left side ; any motion during eating, talking, laughing or yawning, brought on an attack which often lasted a quarter of an hour.
Cataleptic condition ; conscious, but without power to move or speak.
Numbness and deadness, with coldness of fingers of both hands, extending as far as middle of upper arm ; coldness and numbness of face, < left side ; great vertigo and blindness, with prostration of strength ; face pale and haggard ; much emaciation without perceptible cause ; both kidneys sore, with ischuria. θ Paralysis.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Graph.]
Constant yawning, with bloatedness of gastric region.
Inclination to stretch, without being able to satisfy it sufficiently.
Excessively tired and sleepy.
Sleepiness : during day, must lie down ; after dinner.
Perspiration about head, when falling asleep.
Night-sweat.
Constant talking during sleep.
Wetting the bed at night while asleep.
Wakens at night with a suffocative attack.
Bleeding from nose at night.
Light slumber or unrefreshing sleep ; starting ; wandering fancies.
Nightly pains felt in sleep.
Stupid morning sleep.
Cannot go to sleep till late.
Unable to fall asleep before midnight on account of a fixed idea.
Sleepiness.
Great sleepiness by day, goes to sleep early in evening, but during night there is wakefulness, tossing about, heat and anxiety ; dreams anxious and terrifying ; at last sinks into a profound and dull morning sleep.
Great agitation at night ; anxious, frightful dreams.
Sleep disturbed by dreams.
Numerous dreams, with distorted images.
Disturbed sleep.
Dreams : vivid ; anxious ; horrible ; vexations ; about fatal accidents.
   

TIME. [38] [Graph.]
Morning : full of fear ; confusion in head ; feels as if drunken when rising from bed ; vertigo ; semilateral headache ; headache ; pressing pain in eyes ; eye red and agglutinated ; lying in bed cracking in ear ; nose-bleed ; saliva runs from mouth ; dryness of mouth ; violent thirst ; qualmishness ; much mucus in throat ; nausea ; pressure at pit of stomach ; much hard coughing ; accelerated pulse ; perspiration on sternum ; itching in spots on thigh ; burning of heels with crawling ; stupid sleep ; chilliness.
At 9 or 10 A. M. : child cannot open eyes.
Till noon : headache on vertex and nape of neck.
Forenoon : pressure in pit of stomach.
Afternoon : child acts as if it had pain ; rush of blood to head.
At 4 P. M. till evening : chill.
At 5 P. M. : chilliness and coldness of whole body.
During day : trembling ; cough ; leucorrhœa ; salty expectoration ; slow pulse ; must lie down ; great sleepiness.
Evening : vertigo ; sees fiery zigzags around outside of field of vision ; pressing pain in eyes ; cracking in ears when eating ; nosebleed in bed ; had to cry out on account of tearing in zygoma ; hoarseness ; paroxysms of pain from accumulation of gas ; headache ; cough ; salty expectoration ; slow pulse ; dull drawing in coccyx ; cold feet in bed ; goes to sleep early ; heat.
Night : thoughts prevent sleep ; agglutination of lids ; nosebleed ; toothache < ; pains in throat like a plug ; pressure at pit of stomach ; pain in fissura ani ; after an evacuation sharp cutting followed by constriction and aching for several hours ; frequent urination ; seminal emissions ; leucorrheic discharge ; frequent micturition ; suffocating paroxysm ; cough ; itching vesicles and restlessness at night ; itching troublesome ; painful itching of exanthema on back of forearms and dorsum of hand ; wakens with a suffocating attack ; pains felt in sleep ; unable to fall asleep before midnight ; wakefulness ; great agitation ; heat, with scrofulous affections of bones.
After midnight : profuse perspiration lasting till morning ; dry heat.
   

TEMPERATURE AND WEATHER. [39] [Graph.]
Open air : sweat on head when walking ; lachrymation ; fluent coryza < ; chill > Warmth : tearing pain in teeth < ; > crampy pain in stomach ; > scrofulous affection of bones.
Warmth of bed : < itching.
Warm drinks : pain in stomach > ; pain in hepatic region >.
Wind : while walking, drawing pain in molars.
Water : inflamed matrix <.
Bathing after measles : paralysis of face.
Washing : scurf disappears ; feels < after.
Wet feet : delayed menses.
Damp, wet atmosphere : < symptoms.
Cold drinks : stinging toothache ; pain in stomach <.
Cold air : very sensitive to ; fluent coryza < ; scrofulous affections of bones <.
   

FEVER. [40] [Graph.]
Chilliness in morning, in bed.
Shaking chill every day, in evening ; after an hour, hot face and cold feet without subsequent sweat.
Chill in evening, with headache and tearing in limbs, great thirst and profuse perspiration after midnight, lasting till morning.
Chill and chilliness, most in evening.
Chill from 4 P. M. till evening.
Chilliness and coldness of whole body at 5 P. M., with icy-cold feet.
Child < after meals, > after drinking, > in open air.
Sometimes feet are icy-cold, again quite burning.
Flushes of heat.
Violent febrile chilliness morning and evening, the heat followed by sweat.
Dry heat every evening and night, lasting till morning, with headache on vertex and in nape of neck till noon.
Heat evening and night ; with restlessness ; unable to sleep, or remain in bed on account of it.
Hands and soles of feet hot and burning.
Heat when riding in a carriage.
Sweats from slightest motion.
Sweat often on front of body only.
Sweat on front of body and centre of chest (sternum).
Sweat stains yellow, is sour and offensive smelling, and frequently cold.
Fetid sweat.
Profuse sweat on feet ; they swell and become sore.
Profuse night-sweat.
Entire inability to sweat.
Type : quotidian ; double quotidian.
Time : 6 or 7 A. M. ; morning in bed ; afternoon, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 P. M.
Glands are affected, along with hectic ; discharge gluey ; chills and fever (P. M.) ; cold feet ; hot, red face or pale face ; sweat absent, or else offensive. θ Irritable fever.
